$comment: Law 29: architecture invariants are enforced by guards, not prose. pnpm verify runs the guards at gate time; this hook runs them at authorship time, so a violation is reported against the edit that caused it rather than against a batch. Read-only and ~1.4s over the whole workspace. Exit 2 is the blocking-error protocol: the guard output is fed back to the agent, which then fixes it before continuing.
